faqs.question: What does Zelta Design do?
faqs.answer: Zelta Design is a full-service architecture firm for restaurant and commercial projects. We take a project from the first site survey to final inspection: site survey, schematic design, construction documents, permitting and plan review, code and accessibility compliance, MEP (mechanical, electrical and plumbing) coordination and construction administration.

faqs.question: How many projects has the firm completed?
faqs.answer: More than 2,500 restaurant projects for +40 brands, from national quick-service chains to independent operators.

faqs.question: Where is the firm licensed?
faqs.answer: In 25 states: Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, D.C., West Virginia and Wisconsin. We take work across the United States outside California, Alaska and Hawaii, and get licensed in a new state when a client's project needs it.

faqs.question: Who leads the firm?
faqs.answer: Erik Liepins, RA, the owner and principal architect.

faqs.question: Where does Zelta Design work?
faqs.answer: Across the United States outside California, Alaska and Hawaii. We are licensed today in 25 jurisdictions: Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, D.C., West Virginia and Wisconsin. When a client brings us a project in a new state, we get licensed there, well before any drawing needs a seal.

faqs.question: What does a restaurant architect do on a project?
faqs.answer: We take a restaurant from site survey to final inspection: schematic design, construction documents, permitting and plan review, code and accessibility compliance, MEP coordination and construction administration.

faqs.question: Which restaurant brands has Zelta Design worked with?
faqs.answer: +40 brands, including Dunkin', Taco Bell, Popeyes, Dave's Hot Chicken, Buffalo Wild Wings GO, Wendy's, PopUp Bagels, Burger King. We know each brand's current design package and approval process.

faqs.question: Do you design new freestanding restaurants or tenant fit-outs?
faqs.answer: Both: freestanding drive-thrus, inline and end-cap units, food-court counters and multi-level flagships in Manhattan, plus commercial tenant fit-outs.

faqs.question: Can one architect handle all of our locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most of our clients run 20 or more locations. One team handles design, local code requirements and permitting as you expand, including into new states.

faqs.answer: Yes. We take work across the United States outside California, Alaska and Hawaii. When a client brings us a project in a new state, we get licensed there before any drawing needs a seal.

faqs.question: Why does the architect need a license in my state?
faqs.answer: Every state licenses its own architects, and a building department only accepts drawings sealed by someone licensed there.

faqs.question: Who handles the permits in each state?
faqs.answer: The same Zelta Design team handles design, construction documents and local permitting for every location, in every state where we work.
